channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: How People Perceive Risks
item.description: People do not always assess risk according to scientific evidence. Psychological research shows that unfamiliar, invisible and uncontrollable threats often generate greater fear than well-known dangers, even when their actual risks are lower. (Published on November 10, 2026bymedium.com)

item.title: When the Evidence Finds Nothing: The Missing E-Cigarette Marketing Story
item.description: A study examining digital marketing exposure among 31 Aboriginal adults in Australia detected no e-cigarette advertising and very little tobacco promotion, despite including both categories in its assessment of unhealthy product marketing. (Published on November 10, 2026bysubstack.com)

item.title: 77% of Quebec vapers still use banned flavours three years on
item.description: Quebec’s flavour ban has not eliminated demand for flavoured vaping products. Three years after its introduction, 77% of vapers still report using flavours covered by the restrictions, with fruit flavours remaining particularly popular. (Published on November 10, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)
